goal: Fix BUY trade information bug (+0.00 misleading PnL), audit trading fees per order, and implement mobile touch cards vs desktop tabular layout in trade history panels
execution_steps: Fix information bug in BottomActivityPanel: closed BUY orders must show COMPRA EJECUTADA or EN INVENTARIO instead of misleading green +$0.00
Add responsive mobile cards (sm:hidden) in BottomActivityPanel trade history with zero overflow
Update desktop table (hidden sm:block) with fee and gross/net breakdown
Enhance ActiveBotsPanel trade history tab with mobile cards, fee column, and accurate BUY status
Execute automated test suite and oxlint
acceptance_criteria: assert.ok(bottomPanelContent.includes('COMPRA') || bottomPanelContent.includes('INVENTARIO'), 'BottomActivityPanel correctly differentiates BUY vs SELL in trade history')
assert.ok(activeBotsContent.includes('Comisión') || activeBotsContent.includes('Fee') || activeBotsContent.includes('fee'), 'ActiveBotsPanel displays fees in trade history')
definition_of_done: Trade history renders without overflow on mobile devices and provides exact fee transparency
